<!doctype html>
<html lang="de"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Die Herde</title><meta name="generator" content="PathFinder">
<style>/* PathFinder – Lernpfad-Editor
 * Zwei Ebenen: .lp-* ist das Aussehen des Lernpfads (das sehen später die Schüler),
 * .ed-* ist die Bedienung des Editors (nur für die Lehrkraft). */
@font-face { font-family: "Pixelify Sans"; src: url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format("truetype"); font-weight: 400 700; }
@font-face { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible"; src: url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format("truetype"); font-weight: 400; }
@font-face { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible"; src: url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format("truetype"); font-weight: 700; }

:root {
  --fz: 1;
  --bg: #fdf8f3; --surface: #fff; --surface-2: #f7edf2; --ink: #2a2340; --ink-2: #6c6280; --line: #eedbe4;
  --a1: #5b6fc2; --a1s: #b9cdf5; --a2: #c75a8c; --a2s: #f6c3d8; --a3: #f6bf3a; --a3d: #d99a0b; --a3s: #fdf0cf; --a3ink: #2b2300;
  --g1: #b9cdf5; --g2: #f6c3d8; --g3: #fbd98a; --heroink: #2a2340; --good: #3f9a6a; --bad: #c23b3b;
  --font-display: "Pixelify Sans", "Courier New", monospace; --font-body: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --display-weight: 700; --display-ls: 0;
  /* Editor-Bedienung */
  --ed-bg: #1f1b2e; --ed-ink: #f4f1fa; --ed-mid: #3a3450; --ed-acc: #f6bf3a; --ed-sel: #5b8def;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { height: 100%; }
body { margin: 0; font: 15px/1.4 -apple-system, system-ui, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", sans-serif; background: #e9e6ee; color: #222; overflow: hidden; }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* ---------- App-Rahmen ---------- */
.app { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); height: 100%; }
/* Mit App daneben (z. B. FlowPad): links die App, rechts der Lernpfad */
.app.with-side { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(380px, 1.25fr); }
.app.with-side.lp-only { grid-template-columns: 0 1fr; }
.app.lp-only > .pf-side { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .app.with-side { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; } .app.with-side > .pf-side { max-height: 34vh; } }
/* Eigenständig: Lernpfad mittig */
.app:not(.with-side) .lp-main { margin: 0 auto; }

/* ---------- Lernpfad-Bereich mit Editor ---------- */
.lpwrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; background: var(--bg); position: relative; }
.ed-bar { flex: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--ed-bg); color: var(--ed-ink); z-index: 50; }
.ed-bar .sp { flex: 1; }
.ed-seg { display: inline-flex; background: var(--ed-mid); border-radius: 9px; padding: 3px; }
.ed-seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ed-ink); font-weight: 650; padding: 6px 11px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 34px; }
.ed-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ed-ink); color: var(--ed-bg); }
.ed-btn { border: 0; background: var(--ed-mid); color: var(--ed-ink); min-height: 40px; min-width: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 650; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; }
.ed-btn:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }
.ed-btn.on { background: var(--ed-acc); color: #2b2300; }
.ed-btn .k { font-size: 11px; opacity: .65; font-weight: 500; }
.ed-saved { font-size: 12px; opacity: .7; min-width: 5.5em; text-align: right; }
@media (max-width: 1300px) { .ed-btn .t { display: none; } }
@media (max-width: 1000px) { .ed-saved { display: none; } }
.ed-seg button { white-space: nowrap; }

.lp-scroll { flex: 1; overflow: auto; position: relative; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }

/* ---------- Lernpfad-Aussehen (.lp) ---------- */
.lp { font: calc(17px * var(--fz))/1.55 var(--font-body); color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg); min-height: 100%; position: relative; }
.lp .fontsize { position: absolute; z-index: 30; top: 10px; right: 12px; display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.lp .fontsize button { width: 40px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 18%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent); color: var(--ink); font: 700 15px var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; }
.lp-hero { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 26px 18px 22px; color: var(--heroink); overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--g1) 0%, var(--g2) 55%, var(--g3) 100%); border-bottom: 6px solid var(--a3); }
.lp-hero::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: var(--hero-pat, radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.3) 2px, transparent 2px)); background-size: var(--hero-pat-size, 16px 16px); pointer-events: none; }
.lp-hero.has-bg { background-size: cover; background-position: center; }
.lp-hero.has-bg::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent), transparent 75%); }
.lp-hero > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.lp-logo { flex: none; width: 84px; height: 84px; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 700 44px var(--font-display); color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--a2), var(--a1)); border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(40,20,70,.25); overflow: hidden; }
.lp-logo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.lp-hero small { display: block; font: 700 calc(12px * var(--fz))/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .14em; opacity: .8; text-transform: uppercase; }
.lp-hero h1 { margin: 6px 0 4px; font: var(--display-weight) calc(30px * var(--fz))/1.1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: var(--display-ls); }
.lp-hero p { margin: 0; }
.lp-trail { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 90%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.lp-trail-in { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 18px; }
.lp-stops { display: flex; gap: 7px; flex: 1; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; padding: 3px; }
.lp-stops a { flex: none; width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; text-decoration: none; font: 700 calc(16px * var(--fz)) var(--font-display); color: var(--ink-2); background: var(--surface); border: 2px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
.lp-stops a.done { background: var(--a3); border-color: var(--a3d); color: var(--a3ink); }
.lp-stops a.cur { border-color: var(--a1); color: var(--a1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--a1s); }
.lp-stops a.dragging { opacity: .4; }
.lp-stops a.drop-before { box-shadow: -5px 0 0 -1px var(--ed-sel); }
.lp-stops a.drop-after { box-shadow: 5px 0 0 -1px var(--ed-sel); }
.lp-count { font: 700 calc(15px * var(--fz)) var(--font-display); color: var(--ink-2); white-space: nowrap; }
.lp-main { padding: 4px 18px 40px; max-width: 820px; }
.lp-station { padding-top: 4px; scroll-margin-top: 64px; }
.lp-sh { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; margin: 26px 0 10px; }
.lp-sh h2 { margin: 0; font: var(--display-weight) calc(23px * var(--fz))/1.2 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: var(--display-ls); color: var(--a1); }
.lp-sh small { display: block; font: 700 calc(12px * var(--fz)) var(--font-body); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2); }
.lp-nr { flex: none; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: var(--a3); color: var(--a3ink); font: 700 calc(19px * var(--fz)) var(--font-display); }
.lp[data-shape="eckig"] .lp-nr { border: 3px solid var(--a1); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--a2); }
.lp[data-shape="eckig"] .lp-stops a { border-radius: 4px; }
.lp[data-shape="rund"] .lp-nr { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, var(--a3), var(--a3d) 72%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--a3s); }
.lp[data-shape="rund"] .lp-stops a { border-radius: 50%; }
.lp code { font: .9em ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; background: var(--surface-2); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; }
.lp a.link { color: var(--a1); }
.lp p { margin: .5em 0; }
.lp-card { background: var(--surface); border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; margin: 12px 0; }
.lp-ctitle { font-family: var(--font-display); color: var(--a1); font-weight: 700; }
.lp-info { display: flex; gap: 10px; background: var(--a3s); border: 2px dashed var(--a3d); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; margin: 12px 0; }
.lp-info .ic { font-size: 1.3em; line-height: 1.25; }
.lp-info .t { font-family: var(--font-display); color: var(--a2); display: block; font-weight: 700; }
.lp-info.achtung { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 8%, var(--surface)); border-color: var(--bad); }
.lp-info.achtung .t { color: var(--bad); }
.lp-info.begriff { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1s) 45%, var(--surface)); border-color: var(--a1); border-style: solid; }
.lp-info.begriff .t { color: var(--a1); }
.lp-task { border-left: 8px solid var(--a3d); }
.lp-task.ok { border-left-color: var(--good); }
.lp-task .hd { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; }
.lp-state { font-weight: 700; font-size: .88em; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink-2); }
.lp-task.ok .lp-state { color: var(--good); }
.lp-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; margin: 6px 6px 2px 0; border-radius: 9px; border: 3px solid var(--a3d); border-bottom-width: 5px; background: var(--a3); color: var(--a3ink); font: 700 calc(16px * var(--fz))/1 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; }
.lp-btn.alt { border-color: var(--a1); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); }
.lp-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
.lp details { margin-top: 8px; }
.lp summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--a1); font-weight: 700; }
.lp-img { margin: 12px 0; }
.lp-img img { max-width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; display: block; }
.lp-img figcaption { font-size: .85em; color: var(--ink-2); margin-top: 4px; }
.lp-img.side { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; }
.lp-img.side img { max-width: 40%; }
.lp-quiz .opt { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; margin: 6px 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: calc(16px * var(--fz)) var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; }
.lp-quiz .opt.ok { border-color: var(--good); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--good) 12%, var(--surface)); }
.lp-quiz .opt.no { border-color: var(--bad); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 10%, var(--surface)); }
.lp-quiz .fb { font-weight: 700; margin-top: 4px; }
.lp-gap input { font: inherit; width: 7em; padding: 2px 6px; border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); }
.lp-gap input.ok { border-color: var(--good); } .lp-gap input.no { border-color: var(--bad); }
.lp-gap .gapmark { background: var(--a3s); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--a3d); padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 3px; }
.lp-match .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px 12px; margin-top: 8px; }
.lp-match .chip { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--a1s); color: #1d2340; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; border: 2px solid var(--a1); cursor: grab; touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
.lp-match .chip.picked { outline: 3px solid var(--a3); }
.lp-match .chip.used { opacity: .35; }
.lp-match .slot { min-height: 44px; border: 2px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.lp-match .slot .got { font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }
.lp-match .slot.ok { border-color: var(--good); border-style: solid; }
.lp-match .slot.no { border-color: var(--bad); border-style: solid; }
.lp-match .slot.hover { background: var(--a3s); }
.lp-lock.locked > .lp-lock-body { opacity: .4; pointer-events: none; filter: grayscale(.6); }
.lp-lock-note { font-size: .9em; color: var(--ink-2); margin: 4px 0; }
.lp-lock:not(.locked) > .lp-lock-note { display: none; }
.lp-code pre .hl-kw { color: #c792ea; font-weight: 600; } .lp-code pre .hl-ty { color: #7fd1c7; } .lp-code pre .hl-str { color: #c3e88d; } .lp-code pre .hl-num { color: #f9a26c; } .lp-code pre .hl-fn { color: #82aaff; } .lp-code pre .hl-com { color: #8b8fa7; font-style: italic; }
.lp-code pre { margin: 6px 0; background: #1f1b2e; color: #f4f1fa; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 9px; overflow: auto; font: 14px/1.45 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; }
.lp-cert { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--g1), var(--g2)); color: var(--heroink); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; margin: 22px 0 8px; }
.lp-cert .seal { flex: none; width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--a3); color: var(--a3ink); font: 700 26px var(--font-display); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--surface), 0 0 0 7px var(--a3d); }
.lp-cert b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.15em; }
.lp-hud { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin: 14px 0; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 80%, #000); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-display); }
.lp-hud .bar { flex: 1; height: 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.25); overflow: hidden; } .lp-hud .bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--a3); }
.lp .xp { display: inline-block; font: 700 .8em var(--font-display); background: var(--a2); color: #fff; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px; margin-left: 6px; }
.lp[data-form="challenge"] .lp-task { background: linear-gradient(var(--surface), var(--surface)) padding-box, linear-gradient(135deg, var(--a2), var(--a1)) border-box; border: 3px solid transparent; border-left-width: 8px; }
.lp-foot { padding: 16px 18px 22px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: .85em; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }

/* ---------- Bearbeiten-Modus ---------- */
.editing [contenteditable] { outline: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: text; }
.editing [contenteditable]:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-sel) 45%, transparent); }
.editing [contenteditable]:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ed-sel); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-sel) 5%, transparent); }
.editing [contenteditable]:empty::before { content: attr(data-ph); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-2) 70%, transparent); font-style: italic; }
.editing .blk { position: relative; border-radius: 12px; }
.editing .blk:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-sel) 35%, transparent); }
.editing .blk.sel { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ed-sel); }
.editing .blk.drag-ghost { opacity: .35; }
.ed-tools { position: absolute; z-index: 25; top: -20px; right: 8px; display: none; gap: 2px; background: var(--ed-bg); border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
.editing .blk.sel > .ed-tools { display: flex; }
.ed-tools button { width: 36px; height: 34px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ed-ink); border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.ed-tools button:hover { background: var(--ed-mid); }
.ed-tools .grip { cursor: grab; touch-action: none; }
.ed-tools .del { color: #ff8a8a; }
.ed-tools .lbl { color: #cfc6e6; font-size: 11px; padding: 0 6px; align-self: center; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
.ed-plus { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; margin: 2px 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s; }
.editing .ed-plus { opacity: .25; }
.editing .ed-plus:hover, .editing .ed-plus.show, .editing .lp-station.cur .ed-plus { opacity: 1; }
.ed-plus::before, .ed-plus::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-sel) 40%, transparent); }
.ed-plus button { width: 28px; height: 22px; margin: 0 6px; border-radius: 99px; border: 0; background: var(--ed-sel); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1; }
.ed-drop-line { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ed-sel); margin: 4px 0; }
.ed-station-tools { display: none; gap: 4px; margin-left: auto; }
.editing .ed-station-tools { display: flex; }
.ed-station-tools button { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-2); border-radius: 8px; min-width: 36px; height: 32px; cursor: pointer; }
.ed-add-station { display: none; margin: 26px 0 0; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 2px dashed var(--a1); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--a1); font: 700 16px var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; }
.editing .ed-add-station { display: block; }
.editing .only-preview { display: none; }
.lp:not(.editing) .only-edit { display: none; }
.ed-hint { font-size: .82em; color: var(--ink-2); background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; margin-top: 6px; }
.ed-hint b { color: var(--ink); }
.single-station .lp-station:not(.cur) { display: none; }

/* ---------- Auswahlfenster, Einstellungen, Design ---------- */
.ed-pop { position: fixed; z-index: 200; background: #fff; color: #222; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(20,10,40,.35); padding: 12px; width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 20px)); max-height: min(70vh, 560px); overflow: auto; }
.ed-pop h3 { margin: 2px 4px 10px; font-size: 15px; }
.ed-pal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(118px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.ed-pal button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #e3dceb; background: #faf8fc; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 56px; }
.ed-pal button:hover, .ed-pal button.hi { background: #efe9fb; border-color: #8a72e0; }
.ed-pal button b { font-size: 14px; } .ed-pal button span { font-size: 11.5px; color: #776d88; }
.ed-pal .grp { grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a80a0; margin-top: 4px; }
.ed-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 150; background: rgba(20,10,40,.25); }
.ed-dlg { position: fixed; z-index: 210; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: min(520px, calc(100vw - 20px)); max-height: calc(100vh - 40px); overflow: auto; background: #fff; color: #222; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(20,10,40,.4); }
.ed-dlg header { position: sticky; top: 0; background: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; z-index: 1; }
.ed-dlg header b { flex: 1; font-size: 16px; }
.ed-dlg header button { border: 0; background: #eee; border-radius: 9px; min-width: 40px; height: 36px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; }
.ed-dlg header button.ok { background: #5b8def; color: #fff; padding: 0 14px; }
.ed-form { padding: 10px 14px 16px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.ed-form label { display: grid; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; color: #555; }
.ed-form input[type=text], .ed-form input[type=number], .ed-form select, .ed-form textarea { font: 15px system-ui; padding: 8px 10px; border: 2px solid #ddd6e6; border-radius: 9px; width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #222; }
.ed-form textarea { min-height: 70px; resize: vertical; }
.ed-form .mono { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace !important; }
.ed-form .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: end; }
.ed-form .row > * { flex: 1; }
.ed-form .take { flex: none; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: #fdf0cf; border: 2px solid #d99a0b; color: #2b2300; padding: 0 10px; min-height: 40px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
.ed-form .list { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.ed-form .list .it { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
.ed-form .list .it input[type=text] { flex: 1; }
.ed-form .list button, .ed-form .add { border: 1px solid #ddd6e6; background: #faf8fc; border-radius: 8px; min-width: 38px; min-height: 38px; cursor: pointer; }
.ed-form .add { justify-self: start; padding: 0 12px; font-weight: 650; }
.ed-form .chk { display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 500; color: #333; }
.ed-form .chk input { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
.ed-form .help { font-size: 12px; color: #8a80a0; font-weight: 400; }
.ed-form .imgprev { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.ed-form .imgprev img { max-height: 70px; max-width: 120px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #ddd; }

<script>
async function pfLoadApp() {
  try {
    const M = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('pf-mods').textContent);
    if (!(await new Function('return ' + M.inside)())) return null; // darf auch ein Promise sein (Handschlag mit der App)
    const urls = {};
    for (const m of M.mods) { let c = m.code; for (const [spec, name] of Object.entries(m.map)) c = c.split("'" + spec + "'").join("'" + urls[name] + "'").split('"' + spec + '"').join('"' + urls[name] + '"'); urls[m.name] = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([c], { type: 'text/javascript' })); }
    const P = await import(urls[M.entry]);
    return { doc: JSON.parse(document.getElementById('pf-doc-app').textContent), plugins: [P[M.plugin]], host: P[M.host]() };
  } catch (e) { console.warn('App-Erweiterung nicht geladen', e); return null; }
}
</script>

/* ---------- Syntaxhervorhebung für Code-Bausteine (Schüleransicht) ---------- */
const HL_KW = {
  java: 'abstract boolean break byte case catch char class continue default do double else enum extends final finally float for if implements import instanceof int interface long new null package private protected public return short static super switch this throw throws true false try void while var',
  python: 'and as assert break class continue def del elif else except False finally for from global if import in is lambda None nonlocal not or pass raise return True try while with yield print',
  sql: 'select from where and or not insert into values update set delete create table drop alter join inner left right outer on group by order having as distinct count sum avg min max like in is null between limit asc desc primary key',
};
const HL_SETS = {};
export function highlightCode(code, lang) {
  const L = String(lang || '').toLowerCase(), kw = HL_KW[L];
  if (!kw) return esc(code);
  const set = HL_SETS[L] || (HL_SETS[L] = new Set(kw.split(' ')));
  const sql = L === 'sql', py = L === 'python';
  const re = py ? /(#.*$)|("(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*"|'(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)*')|(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b)|([A-Za-z_äöüÄÖÜß]\w*)/gm
    : sql ? /(--.*$)|("(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*"|'(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)*')|(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b)|([A-Za-z_äöüÄÖÜß]\w*)/gm
      : /(\/\/.*$|\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/)|("(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*"|'(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)')|(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b)|([A-Za-z_äöüÄÖÜß][\wäöüÄÖÜß]*)/gm;
  let out = '', last = 0, m;
  while ((m = re.exec(code))) {
    out += esc(code.slice(last, m.index)); last = re.lastIndex;
    const t = esc(m[0]);
    if (m[1]) out += `<span class="hl-com">${t}</span>`;
    else if (m[2]) out += `<span class="hl-str">${t}</span>`;
    else if (m[3]) out += `<span class="hl-num">${t}</span>`;
    else {
      const w = m[0];
      if (set.has(sql ? w.toLowerCase() : w)) out += `<span class="hl-kw">${t}</span>`;
      else if (!sql && /^\s*\(/.test(code.slice(re.lastIndex)) && !/^[A-Z]/.test(w)) out += `<span class="hl-fn">${t}</span>`;
      else if (!sql && /^[A-Z]/.test(w)) out += `<span class="hl-ty">${t}</span>`;
      else out += t;
    }
  }
  return out + esc(code.slice(last));
}

  async function loadImage(file) {
    if (file.type === 'image/gif' || file.type === 'image/svg+xml') { if (file.size > 3e6) toast(`⚠ Das Bild ist ${(file.size / 1e6).toFixed(1)} MB groß – das macht den Lernpfad schwer.`, 3500); return await new Promise(r => { const fr = new FileReader(); fr.onload = () => r(fr.result); fr.readAsDataURL(file); }); }
    const img = await new Promise((res, rej) => { const i = new Image(); i.onload = () => res(i); i.onerror = rej; i.src = URL.createObjectURL(file); });
    const max = 1600, sc = Math.min(1, max / img.naturalWidth), c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = Math.round(img.naturalWidth * sc); c.height = Math.round(img.naturalHeight * sc);
    c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    const png = file.type === 'image/png' && file.size < 400e3;
    return c.toDataURL(png ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg', .85);
  }

  function exportDoc(settings) {

    for (const st of d.stations) for (const b of st.blocks) {
      // was die Lehrkraft verborgen hat, kommt gar nicht erst in die Datei
      if (b.tipsHide && b.tips) { b.tips = b.tips.filter((t, i) => !b.tipsHide[i]); delete b.tipsHide; }
      if (b.solHide) { b.solution = ''; delete b.solHide; }

        catch (er) { t.disabled = false; toast('Übernehmen fehlgeschlagen: ' + esc(er.message)); }
        return;
      }
      if (t.dataset.go) {
        st.pass = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, +($('#exPass', el)?.value ?? st.pass))); st.cert = $('#exCert', el).checked;
        t.disabled = true; t.textContent = 'erstelle …';
        try {
          const { d } = exportDoc(st);
          const html = st.fmt === 'app' ? await appHtml(st) : await buildHtml(d, st.fmt === 'scorm');
          if (st.fmt === 'app') download(new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }), fileName(`_${bundled.name}.html`));
          else if (st.fmt === 'html') download(new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }), fileName('.html'));
          else download(new Blob([zip({ 'imsmanifest.xml': manifest(d), 'index.html': html })], { type: 'application/zip' }), fileName('_SCORM.zip'));
          closeDlg(false); toast(st.fmt === 'app' ? `⇩ Lernpfad für ${esc(bundled.name)} erstellt` : st.fmt === 'html' ? '⇩ HTML-Datei erstellt' : '⇩ SCORM-Lernpaket erstellt – in Moodle als „Lernpaket“ hochladen');
        } catch (er) { t.disabled = false; t.textContent = 'Exportieren'; toast('Export fehlgeschlagen: ' + esc(er.message)); }
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- SCORM 1.2: Verbindung zur Lernplattform ---------- */
  function scormConnect() {
    let API = null;
    try { let w = window; for (let n = 0; w && n < 12; n++) { if (w.API) { API = w.API; break; } if (w === w.parent) break; w = w.parent; } } catch (e) { }
    try { if (!API && window.opener && window.opener.API) API = window.opener.API; } catch (e) { }
    if (!API) return { ok: false, get: () => '', report() { }, finish() { } };
    const t0 = Date.now();
    API.LMSInitialize('');
    const st = API.LMSGetValue('cmi.core.lesson_status');
    if (!st || st === 'not attempted') API.LMSSetValue('cmi.core.lesson_status', 'incomplete');
    const nInter = () => +API.LMSGetValue('cmi.interactions._count') || 0;
    return {
      ok: true,
      get: k => API.LMSGetValue(k),
      report(txt) {
        const checks = doc.stations.flatMap(s => { const c = s.blocks.filter(isCheck); return c.map(b => ({ id: b.id, w: doc.pointsOn ? ptsOf(b) : doc.form === 'challenge' ? (+b.xp || 1) : 1 })).concat(s.check ? [{ id: 'st:' + s.id, w: doc.form === 'challenge' || doc.pointsOn ? 0 : 1 }] : []); });
        const max = checks.reduce((a, c) => a + c.w, 0) || 1, got = checks.filter(c => prog.solved[c.id]).reduce((a, c) => a + c.w, 0);
        const pct = Math.round(100 * got / max);
        API.LMSSetValue('cmi.core.score.min', '0'); API.LMSSetValue('cmi.core.score.max', '100'); API.LMSSetValue('cmi.core.score.raw', String(pct));
        const allDone = checks.every(c => prog.solved[c.id]);
        API.LMSSetValue('cmi.core.lesson_status', pct >= (doc.pass ?? 80) ? 'passed' : allDone ? 'failed' : 'incomplete');
        prog.sent = prog.sent || []; // schon gemeldete Ergebnisse (SCORM 1.2 kann sie nicht zurücklesen)
        for (const c of checks) if (prog.solved[c.id] && !prog.sent.includes(c.id)) {
          const n = nInter(); prog.sent.push(c.id);
          API.LMSSetValue(`cmi.interactions.${n}.id`, String(c.id).replace(/[^\w:-]/g, '_'));
          API.LMSSetValue(`cmi.interactions.${n}.type`, 'performance');
          API.LMSSetValue(`cmi.interactions.${n}.result`, 'correct');
        }
        API.LMSSetValue('cmi.suspend_data', JSON.stringify({ ...JSON.parse(txt), sent: prog.sent }).slice(0, 4096));
        API.LMSCommit('');
      },
      finish(txt) {
        const s = Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000), hh = String(Math.floor(s / 3600)).padStart(4, '0'), mm = String(Math.floor(s / 60) % 60).padStart(2, '0'), ss = String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0');
        API.LMSSetValue('cmi.core.session_time', `${hh}:${mm}:${ss}`);
        API.LMSSetValue('cmi.core.exit', 'suspend');
        API.LMSCommit(''); API.LMSFinish('');
      },
    };
  }

  /* ---------- Schnittstelle für Erweiterungen und die App ---------- */
  const ctx = {
    E, esc, plain, uid, ce, toast, imgHtml, xpTag, taskCard, shuffled, findBlock, blockLabel, host,
    get prog() { return prog; }, get doc() { return doc; }, get mode() { return mode; },
    solve: id => solve(id), render: () => render(),
    openDoc: d => openDoc(d), get current() { return doc; },
    /** Lernpfad als Datei für die App (Erweiterung eingebaut) – für „Fertig“ im Editor der App */
    buildForApp: () => { if (pending) commit(); return appHtml({ pass: doc.pass || 80, cert: doc.cert?.on !== false }); },
    get dirty() { return hist.length > 1; },
    /** vorhandene HTML-Lernpfad-Seite öffnen (Originaldesign); liefert das Dokument oder null */
    importHtml: html => importPage(html),
  };
  save(); render(); updUndo();
  host.attach?.(ctx);
  return ctx;
}
